rows.label: tlk70000153_01_msg0001
rows.name: [ML:Feeling kind=Anger ]How dare you break my seal?!

rows.label: tlk70000153_01_msg0014
rows.name:
[ML:Feeling kind=Anger ]In this room packed with gold,
silver, and treasure!

rows.label: tlk70000153_01_msg0005
rows.name:
[ML:Feeling kind=Think ] Perhaps this was my fault for making
a release mechanism. Hard to blame
adventurers for their curiosity...

rows.label: tlk70000153_01_msg0006
rows.name:
[ML:Feeling kind=Think ] The only problem is, I now need
to procure great volumes of cash
to create a new seal...

rows.label: tlk70000153_01_msg0007
rows.name:
[ML:Feeling kind=Think ] Maybe I'll use adventurers' curiosity
to make a little money...

rows.label: tlk70000153_01_msg0009
rows.name:
They're noble, brave, sublime, and
absurdly strong.

rows.label: tlk70000153_01_msg0010
rows.name:
If you pay me, I'll tell you where
they are.

rows.label: tlk70000153_01_msg0011
rows.name:
If you're strong enough to break my
seal, I'm sure you can have a
blood-boiling battle.
